narrative.headline: Still in the hunt
narrative.blurb: The math is alive. Toronto needs a heater — and a few losses from the clubs they are chasing.

magicNumber.hint: Jays wins + TEX losses to clinch a playoff spot
magicNumber.detail: Any mix of Jays wins and TEX losses that adds to 8 locks a playoff spot. Winning out still requires 3 TEX losses. East title is 26 vs TB.

injuries.name: Trent Grisham
injuries.comment: Manager Aaron Boone said Sunday that Grisham (hamstring) isn't expected to come off the injured list before the end of the regular season but could return for the playoffs, Bryan Hoch of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Jazz Chisholm Jr.
injuries.comment: Manager Aaron Boone said Sunday that Chisholm (thumb) could be reinstated from the injured list as early as Tuesday, Gary Phillips of the New York Daily News reports.

injuries.name: Aaron Judge
injuries.comment: Judge said Saturday that he didn't know the grade of his calf strain, Gary Phillips of the New York Daily News reports. "I gotta talk to the trainers and figure that out," Judge said.

injuries.name: Ryan Weathers
injuries.comment: Manager Aaron Boone said Friday that Weathers (forearm) likely won't return in time to pitch again in the regular season, Bryan Hoch of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Fernando Cruz
injuries.comment: Cruz (elbow) expects to resume a throwing program by the end of this week, Meredith Marakovits of YES Network reports.

injuries.name: Kervin Castro
injuries.comment: The Yankees transferred Castro (elbow) from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Giancarlo Stanton
injuries.comment: The Yankees transferred Stanton (calf) to the 60-day injured list Tuesday.

injuries.name: Garrett Crochet
injuries.comment: Crochet (shoulder) threw a two-inning side session Saturday, Ian Browne of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Tanner Houck
injuries.comment: Houck (elbow) allowed two runs (one earned) on two hits while striking two over 3.1 innings for Triple-A Worcester on Saturday.

injuries.name: Willson Contreras
injuries.comment: Contreras (hand) is out of the lineup for Sunday's game against the Rays, Christopher Smith of MassLive.com reports.

injuries.name: Aroldis Chapman
injuries.comment: Chapman (lat) will not pitch this weekend but is expected to return during the team's final homestand next week, Ian Browne of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Johan Oviedo
injuries.comment: Ovideo (elbow) allowed one run on two hits and one walk while striking out four for Triple-A Worcester on Thursday.

injuries.name: Ceddanne Rafaela
injuries.comment: Rafaela (quadriceps) is with Triple-A Worcester on Thursday and will do some hitting off their Trajekt machine, Tommy Cassell of the Worcester Telegram & Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Justin Slaten
injuries.comment: Interim manager Chad Tracy said Tuesday that Slaten (elbow) will not return from the injured list this season, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.

injuries.name: Curtis Mead
injuries.comment: Mead (wrist) will begin hitting off a tee Wednesday, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.

injuries.name: Anthony Seigler
injuries.comment: The Red Sox placed Seigler on the 10-day injured list Sunday due to right wrist inflammation.

injuries.name: Eli White
injuries.comment: Boston placed White on the 10-day injured list with a right foot ligament injury Friday, retroactive to Sept. 9.

injuries.name: Kutter Crawford
injuries.comment: Crawford (forearm) is expected to remain on the injured list for the rest of the season, Jen McCaffrey of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Eduardo Rivera
injuries.comment: The Red Sox recalled Rivera from Triple-A Worcester and placed him on the 60-day injured list Tuesday due to a lumbar strain.

injuries.name: Masataka Yoshida
injuries.comment: Interim manager Chad Tracy revealed Tuesday that Yoshida has a "significant" left hamstring injury that will keep him out until close to the end of the season, at minimum, Tim Healey of The Boston Globe reports.

injuries.name: Triston Casas
injuries.comment: Casas (abdomen/knee) underwent arthroscopic surgery on his left wrist Thursday.

injuries.name: Zack Kelly
injuries.comment: The Red Sox recalled Kelly (elbow) from Triple-A Worcester and placed him on the 60-day injured list Tuesday, Tim Healey of The Boston Globe reports.

injuries.name: Tristan Peters
injuries.comment: Peters (shoulder/rib) isn't in the lineup for Sunday's game against the Tigers.

injuries.name: Prelander Berroa
injuries.comment: Berroa (elbow) is scheduled to begin throwing off a mound next week, Scott Merkin of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Ky Bush
injuries.comment: Bush (elbow) has been shut down for the 2026 season due to a strained left lat, Scott Merkin of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Leasure
injuries.comment: Leasure underwent surgery to repair a torn UCL in August, James Fegan of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

injuries.name: Joey Bart
injuries.comment: White Sox general manager Chris Getz said Friday that Bart is expected to be sidelined for "over a month" due to a left hand fracture, James Fegan of SoxMachine.com reports.

injuries.name: Mike Vasil
injuries.comment: The White Sox transferred Vasil (elbow) from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Tuesday.

injuries.name: Tanner Murray
injuries.comment: The White Sox transferred Murray (shoulder) to the 60-day injured list Monday.

injuries.name: Brooks Baldwin
injuries.comment: The White Sox transferred Baldwin (elbow) from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Enyel De Los Santos
injuries.comment: De Los Santos secured the save Thursday against the Tigers, allowing one run on two hits and no walks in the ninth inning. He did not record a strikeout.

injuries.name: Steven Okert
injuries.comment: Okert (hamstring) will not return from the injured list before the end of the regular season, Brian McTaggart of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Carlos Correa
injuries.comment: Medical imaging on Correa's surgically repaired left ankle revealed inflammation Thursday, Chandler Rome of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Mike Burrows
injuries.comment: The Astros transferred Burrows (elbow) to the 60-day injured list Sunday.

injuries.name: Brandon Walter
injuries.comment: The Astros announced Friday that Walter (elbow) is in the midst of a throwing progression at the team's complex in West Palm Beach, Fla., Chandler Rome of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Brett Bateman
injuries.comment: Bateman left Monday's game against Baltimore due to right hip discomfort, Hazel Mae of Sportsnet reports.

injuries.name: Dylan Cease
injuries.comment: Cease does not need surgery on his injured right shoulder, but his immediate availability is up in the air, Hazel Mae of Sportsnet reports.

injuries.name: Vladimir Guerrero Jr.
injuries.comment: Guerrero (back) is absent from the lineup for Monday's game in Baltimore.

injuries.name: Anthony Santander
injuries.comment: Santander (shoulder/back) is scheduled to play in the outfield for Triple-A Buffalo on Friday, Arden Zwelling of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Shane Bieber
injuries.comment: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said Friday that it "would be tough" for Bieber (shoulder) to return from the 15-day injured list before the end of the regular season, Hazel Mae of Sportsnet reports.

injuries.name: Jameson Taillon
injuries.comment: Taillon (elbow) revealed his "season is over" Tuesday and confirmed he'll be evaluated by Dr. Keith Meister in Texas on Sept. 22, Shi Davidi of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Rudy Martin Jr.
injuries.comment: The Blue Jays selected Martin's contract from Triple-A Buffalo on Friday, Jeff Passan of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Cody Ponce
injuries.comment: Manager John Schneider said that Ponce (knee) would be a candidate to return from the 60-day injured list only if the Blue Jays make the postseason and advanced deep into October, Arden Zwelling of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Patrick Corbin
injuries.comment: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said Saturday that Corbin (shoulder) is a "long shot" to return from the 60-day injured list this season, Arden Zwelling of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Jonatan Clase
injuries.comment: The Blue Jays transferred Clase (foot) to the 60-day injured list Thursday, Shi Davidi of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Yimi Garcia
injuries.comment: Garcia (elbow/neck/biceps) underwent thoracic outlet surgery Thursday and will miss the rest of the season, Arden Zwelling of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Jake Bloss
injuries.comment: The Blue Jays recalled Bloss from Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday and placed him on the 60-day injured list while he recovers from a right teres major strain, Arden Zwelling of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Luis Urias
injuries.comment: The Blue Jays announced Monday that Urias (quadriceps) will be shut down for the next two weeks, Ben Nicholson-Smith of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Addison Barger
injuries.comment: Barger is expected to be sidelined six months following surgery Monday to repair his right elbow UCL, Shi Davidi of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Jose Berrios
injuries.comment: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said that Berrios underwent full Tommy John surgery Wednesday in addition to having a stress fracture repaired, Hazel Mae of Sportsnet reports.

injuries.name: Bowden Francis
injuries.comment: The Blue Jays placed Francis (elbow) on the 60-day injured list Wednesday.

injuries.name: Samuel Basallo
injuries.comment: Basallo was removed from Monday's game against Toronto after taking a foul ball off his mask, Andy Kostka of TheBanner.com reports.

injuries.name: Jackson Holliday
injuries.comment: Orioles manager Craig Albernaz said Monday that it's unlikely Holliday (wrist) will return this season, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Tyler O'Neill
injuries.comment: Manager Craig Albernaz said Monday that O'Neill's shoulder isn't responding to rehab the way they'd hoped, and he's dealing with a "significant" injury, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Ryan Helsley
injuries.comment: President of baseball operations Mike Elias said Saturday that Helsley (elbow) will be shut down for the remainder of the season, Andy Kostka of TheBanner.com reports.

injuries.name: Kyle Bradish
injuries.comment: Bradish was diagnosed with a sports hernia Wednesday, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Blaze Alexander
injuries.comment: The Orioles placed Alexander on the 10-day injured list Wednesday with low-back discomfort.

injuries.name: Ryan Mountcastle
injuries.comment: Mountcastle (foot/oblique) has resumed a hitting progression, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Luis Robert Jr.
injuries.comment: The Orioles placed Robert on the 10-day injured list Sunday due to left hamstring discomfort.

injuries.name: Colin Selby
injuries.comment: Orioles president of baseball operations Mike Elias said Friday that Selby underwent right shoulder surgery Tuesday to repair his labrum and rotator cuff, Andy Kostka of TheBanner.com reports.

injuries.name: Keegan Akin
injuries.comment: Akin (elbow) underwent Tommy John surgery Wednesday, Jake Rill of MLB.com  reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Westburg
injuries.comment: Westburg (elbow) underwent Tommy John surgery Wednesday, Andrew Golden of TheBanner.com reports.

injuries.name: Colt Keith
injuries.comment: The Tigers placed Keith on the 10-day injured list Monday due to a left thumb sprain.

injuries.name: Troy Melton
injuries.comment: The Tigers placed Melton on the 15-day injured list Monday due to right arm fatigue.

injuries.name: Justin Verlander
injuries.comment: Verlander (hamstring/hip) is scheduled to be reinstated from the 60-day injured list to start Saturday against the Pirates, Jeff Seidel of the Detroit Free Press reports.

injuries.name: Kyle Finnegan
injuries.comment: The Tigers placed Finnegan on the 15-day injured list Thursday, retroactive to Wednesday, with left groin inflammation.

injuries.name: Kerry Carpenter
injuries.comment: The Tigers announced Friday that Carpenter (foot) has ramped up his running and hitting progression with the hope of returning from the injured list before the end of the season, MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Jack Flaherty
injuries.comment: Flaherty (forearm) is slated to throw a 2-to-3-inning simulated game Saturday, Jason Beck of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Wenceel Perez
injuries.comment: Tigers manager A.J. Hinch said Friday that Perez (orbital) is "most likely" done for the season, Cody Stavenhagen of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Matt Vierling
injuries.comment: The Tigers transferred Vierling (adductor/heel) from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Sunday, Jason Beck of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Will Vest
injuries.comment: Vest (elbow) underwent hip surgery Tuesday, Chris McCosky of The Detroit News reports.

injuries.name: Burch Smith
injuries.comment: Smith is being evaluated after exiting a rehab appearance with Triple-A Toledo on Thursday with right shoulder/lat discomfort, Cody Stavenhagen of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Bailey Horn
injuries.comment: Horn (elbow) will undergo season-ending Tommy John surgery, Chris McCosky of The Detroit News reports.

injuries.name: Parker Meadows
injuries.comment: Tigers manager A.J. Hinch said Tuesday that Meadows (forearm) has yet to resume hitting and is without a timeline to return from the 60-day injured list, Evan Petzold of the Detroit Free Press reports.

injuries.name: Trey Sweeney
injuries.comment: Sweeney will undergo season-ending shoulder surgery this week, Cody Stavenhagen of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Reese Olson
injuries.comment: The Tigers placed Olson on the 60-day injured list Tuesday after he underwent a right shoulder labral repair Feb. 2 that will result in him missing the 2026 season.

injuries.name: Andres Munoz
injuries.comment: Munoz (knee) will undergo imaging to diagnose his injury Monday, Ryan Divish of The Seattle Times reports.

injuries.name: Nick Davila
injuries.comment: The Mariners placed Davila on the 15-day injured list Monday with a right SC joint sprain in his shoulder.

injuries.name: Matt Brash
injuries.comment: Brash has been shut down from throwing for eight weeks after an MRI revealed more inflammation in his lat, Ryan Divish of The Seattle Times reports.

injuries.name: Brendan Donovan
injuries.comment: Donovan continues to experience concussion symptoms, Ryan Divish of The Seattle Times reports.

injuries.name: Brennen Davis
injuries.comment: The Mariners recalled Davis (hamstring) from Triple-A Tacoma on Thursday and placed him on the 60-day injured list.

injuries.name: Colt Emerson
injuries.comment: The Mariners transferred Emerson (wrist) from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Monday.

injuries.name: Emerson Hancock
injuries.comment: Seattle placed Hancock (groin) on the 15-day injured list Sunday with a left adductor strain, retroactive to Aug. 29.

injuries.name: Luke Raley
injuries.comment: The Mariners transferred Raley (forearm) from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Cole Wilcox
injuries.comment: Wilcox left Thursday's game versus the Tigers due to left oblique tightness.

injuries.name: Will Wilson
injuries.comment: Wilson (thumb) has gone 3-for-9 with two RBI and a 1:2 BB:K in his first three rehab games between High-A Everett and Triple-A Tacoma.

injuries.name: Logan Evans
injuries.comment: The Mariners placed Evans (elbow) on the 60-day injured list Monday.

playoffOdds.method: Monte Carlo of remaining American League games. Each game uses log5 win odds from Pythagorean record, season record, last-10 form, home-field advantage, and injured-list drag.
playoffOdds.note: 0.2% of 5,000 sims have Toronto as a division winner or one of the three AL wild cards. Models 55 remaining games involving AL clubs.

kpis.hint: Jays losses + rival wins that ends it
